Feature Specification: SSE parity diagnostics

## Goal
Compare the legacy browser SSE stream with the native shadow stream without processing an order twice.

## Contract
- Legacy EventSource remains authoritative.
- Legacy raw event.data is SHA-256 fingerprinted before JSON parsing.
- Native shadow fingerprints the raw assembled SSE data frame.
- Diagnostics expose counts, last hashes, matches and mismatches only.
- No native fingerprint event may invoke order, acceptance, payment, storage or printing business handlers.

## Acceptance
Automated architecture/build verification plus physical same-stream comparison and reconnect testing are required before transport cutover.

Feature Specification: Shadow SSE lifecycle

## Goal
Keep diagnostic native SSE bounded to the foreground Activity while preserving legacy WEB-order behavior.

## Rules
- Backgrounding cancels only the native shadow call/job.
- Explicit shadow intent/config is retained across background/foreground.
- Foreground resumes shadow observation when previously requested.
- Explicit stop and Activity destroy clear/cancel shadow state.
- Legacy EventSource remains untouched and authoritative.

## Acceptance
Automated build plus physical background/foreground and network interruption verification before any cutover.

Feature Specification: Continuous SSE diagnostics

## Goal
Preserve shadow SSE diagnostic evidence across Activity background/foreground reconnects.

## Rules
- Explicit fresh start resets counters and last hash.
- Lifecycle resume does not reset event count, reconnect count, or last hash.
- SHA-256 input encoding is explicitly UTF-8.
- No business payload is persisted or replayed.
- Legacy EventSource remains authoritative.

## Acceptance
Automated build plus physical background/reconnect comparison before cutover.
